messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — saw a perf dip on an 8xA100 run after the kernel-selector change. p50 token latency +12% on long seqs. profile: /tmp/trace_1923456789.nsys
Maya: which NCCL config? LL vs LL128?
Alex: Started with NCCL_PROTO=LL and NCCL_ALGO=RING. After selector change that prefers fused kernels, overlap looks worse — allreduce waiting more.
Chen: Can you paste the timeline/snippet? suspect KV prefetch and memcpy ordering.
Alex: nsys summary excerpt: ```
GPU0 kernel_compute  1.02ms
KV_fetch memcpy     0.08ms
Allreduce wait      0.60ms
GPU0 kernel_tail     0.40ms
```
Sam: Try forcing NCCL_PROTO=LL128 + NCCL_ALGO=TREE as an experiment? :thinking: Also check NCCL_MIN_NTHREADS and LAUNCH_MODE.
Priya: infra metrics show elevated PCIe stalls on node-3 around the runs.
InfraBot: node-3 metrics — PCIe_TLP: 1.9e6, PCIe_STALL: 0.7%, NVLINK_RETRY: 0.02%
Chen: Also note we bumped max_batch_tokens -> 4096 in the batcher last week. Larger batches can shift comm/compute overlap.
Jordan: Quick plan — try LL128 + TREE + socket interface ib0, 5 iters, compare p50/p95/p99.
Alex: Did that: export NCCL_PROTO=LL128; export NCCL_ALGO=TREE. p50 improved ~9% vs baseline but p99 still noisy. timeline still shows occasional long allreduce waits.
Sam: Can you repro with KV prefetch off? run with KV_PREFETCH=0 in the runtime config.
Alex: With KV_PREFETCH=0 p99 becomes stable. Looks like KV prefetch introduces memcpy bursts that collide with the LL allreduce microsteps when using LL proto.
Priya: Suggest: selector rule -> if kv_prefetch==enabled and seq_len>1024, prefer LL128 + smaller chunking (reduce allreduce window).
Maya: +1 — add an automated perf test toggling kv_prefetch x NCCL_PROTO combos in runtime-suites.
Chen: I'll open a tiny PR to add the harness and nsys script, and add a selector heuristic patch. tagging @Alex for logs.
Alex: timeline snippet for the noisy run: ```TIMELINE: compute(1000us) -> memcpy(KV) 70us -> allreduce(wait 600us) -> compute```
InfraBot: Created issue INF-4922 and attached /tmp/trace_1923456789.nsys, logs, and node metrics :thumbsup:
Sam: Nice find. After the PR lands, let's run the suite on 4-node and 2 different tensor/pipeline shardings to validate at scale.
